CutScene.Text: With the knowledge that a counter-spell existed, the task of stopping Aravein finally seemed possible.
It was at this moment that Kelthurax chose to speak again:
“You now know the cure… but you have not yet found the disease.”
“To use this spell, you must first find Aravein and confront her. And you will not find her… not in time… I can tell you where she is, but once again, you must pay a price.”
“Bring me the Gems from the Throne of the Selentine Emperor, and I will tell you what you need to know.”
No amount of pleading or reasoning could change Kelthurax’s mind. Such is the danger of dealing with dragons.
